basic_details.job_title: CCI Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 29 Office Manager, Additional Director General and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Competition Commission of India (CCI) is filling 29 posts in the office of Director General, CCI, on deputation on foreign service terms. The posts are Additional Director General, Joint Director General and Deputy Director General (Professional Staff), and Deputy Director General (CS), Assistant Director General (CS) and Office Manager (CS) (Administrative Staff). Applications go through proper channel to the Deputy Director (HR), Competition Commission of India, New Delhi. They must reach the office by 21 December 2026 (5:00 PM). content_sections.heading: About CCI
content_sections.text: The Competition Commission of India (भारतीय प्रतिस्पर्धा आयोग) has its office at Office Block-1, 9th Floor, Kidwai Nagar (East), New Delhi – 110023 (Tel: 011-24664100, Fax: 011-20815022). These posts are in the office of Director General, CCI. The Office Memorandum was issued by the HR Division of the Commission.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications must be complete in every respect and must use the prescribed pro-forma in Annexure-III of the notice. The candidate's employer forwards them through proper channel. Only eligible and willing candidates whose services can be released immediately on selection should be forwarded. The application, with all the documents listed under Enclosures below, must reach this address by 21 December 2026 (5:00 PM): Deputy Director (HR), Competition Commission of India, 9th Floor, Office Block-1, Kidwai Nagar (East), New Delhi-110023 Fill in the Format of Application (Annexure-III) and paste a copy of a passport size photograph in the space provided. Fill in items 1 to 20. These cover the post applied for, date of birth, date of superannuation, service, present employer's status, present and substantive posts with pay details, educational qualification from Matric onwards, how you meet the essential and desirable requirements, and your employment history in chronological order. Under item 14, give your experience of handling investigation or enforcement of any economic or regulatory law, and your experience in Competition Law/Matters. Name the laws and the number of years. If you do not hold a post in the new Pay Matrix, Pay Band or Grade Pay of the Central Government, state how your pay scale compares with the Central Government's pay scales and attach supporting documents. Sign the declaration. It confirms that the Selection Committee will also assess your Curriculum Vitae and supporting documents at the time of selection. Have your Employer, Head of Office or Forwarding Authority complete the certificate on the last page of the form, with signature, name, designation, telephone number and office seal, and list the enclosures. Have the employer forward the application through proper channel so that it reaches the Deputy Director (HR), CCI by 21 December 2026 (5:00 PM). The form says separate applications may be submitted for separate posts. Applications received after 21 December 2026 (5:00 PM) will not be considered. content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Application in the prescribed pro-forma (Annexure-III), with a copy of a passport size photograph pasted on it Cadre Clearance Vigilance Clearance Integrity Certificate Attested copies of up-to-date APARs for the last five years. The employer's certificate allows either the CR/APAR dossier in original, or photocopies of the ACRs/APAR for the last five years attested by an officer of the rank of Under Secretary to the Govt. of India or above. Certificate from the Employer/Head of Office/Forwarding Authority (last page of Annexure-III). It must confirm that the details are correct, that the applicant has the required qualifications and experience, and that the applicant will be relieved immediately if selected. It must also confirm that no vigilance, disciplinary or criminal case is pending or contemplated, that integrity is certified, that no major or minor penalty was imposed in the last ten years (or enclose a list of such penalties), and that the cadre controlling authority has no objection. Supporting documents on pay-scale equivalence, for applicants not holding a post in the Central Government's new Pay Matrix, Pay Band or Grade Pay

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: A Selection Committee constituted for the post decides the selection. Under the applicant's declaration in Annexure-III, the Selection Committee will also assess the candidate's Curriculum Vitae and supporting documents at the time of selection. Candidates may be called for an interaction with the Selection Committee. No TA/DA will be paid for attending it. For the Professional Staff posts, the Selection Committee may consider any equivalent degree it finds useful under the desirable qualification.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in CCI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 29 vacancies: Additional Director General 02, Joint Director General 07, Deputy Director General 12, Deputy Director General (CS) 01, Assistant Director General (CS) 03 and Office Manager (CS) 04. The number is liable to change without notice.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date for CCI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the Deputy Director (HR), CCI, New Delhi by 21 December 2026 (5:00 PM). Applications received after that date and time will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the CCI deputation posts?
faq.answer: The requirement varies by post. Deputy Director General (CS) and Assistant Director General (CS) need a Bachelor's Degree or equivalent in any discipline from a recognised university, plus the experience printed for each post. The Professional Staff posts need service, grade and investigation or enforcement experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for CCI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age for appointment on deputation must not exceed 56 years as on the closing date of receipt of applications by CCI, which is 21 December 2026 (5:00 PM).

faq.question: Q5. What is the pay for CCI Recruitment 2026 posts?
faq.answer: Pay ranges from Level 09 (Rs.53100-167800) for Office Manager (CS) to Level 13A (Rs.131100-216600) for Additional Director General under the 7th CPC. DA, HRA and Transport Allowance etc. are paid at Central Government rates.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for CCI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the Annexure-III pro-forma and have your employer forward it through proper channel. Attach Cadre Clearance, Vigilance Clearance, an Integrity Certificate and attested copies of your APARs for the last five years. It must reach the Deputy Director (HR), Competition Commission of India, 9th Floor, Office Block-1, Kidwai Nagar (East), New Delhi-110023.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: A Selection Committee constituted for the post will assess the candidate's Curriculum Vitae and supporting documents, and may call candidates for an interaction. No TA/DA is paid for the interaction.

faq.question: Q8. Is the CCI appointment permanent?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is on deputation on foreign service terms for three years, subject to satisfactory performance.

faq.question: Q9. Do CCI deputation officers get CGHS benefits?
faq.answer: No. CGHS benefits are not admissible to the officers of the office of DG, CCI. Medical reimbursement is given under the CCI service rules instead.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply for more than one post in CCI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes. The application format says separate applications may be submitted for separate posts.
